description: This Java class implements a cache for notification rules in the Thingsboard platform, managing cache initialization, eviction, and retrieval of notification rules based on tenant ID and trigger type.

classes.name: DefaultNotificationRulesCache
classes.description: Implements caching for notification rules, handling cache initialization, eviction on component lifecycle events, and retrieval of enabled rules for tenants.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the caffeine cache with maximum size and expiration settings.

methods.name: onComponentLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Handles component lifecycle events to evict cache entries when notification rules or tenants are deleted.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves enabled notification rules for a tenant and trigger type, fetching from cache or loading from service if absent.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Invalidates all cache entries related to a specific tenant.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on tenant ID and trigger type.
